aspects.says: A pool keeps a bounded number of connections open and hands a released one out again instead of opening a new one.

aspects.says: Robust connection management also reconnects after failures, secures the link with TLS and bounds connect and read times.
basis: section:11.2 Key Features of Connection Management
aspects.reason: listed but not shown on the page, and each needs a live peer; a graded run is offline

aspects.says: A jPOS channel obtains its sockets through an ISOClientSocketFactory, so how connections are made can change without changing the channel.
aspects.reason: the factory's sockets connect to a live host; a graded run has no network, so the pooling behind it is practised on its own

aspects.says: A pooled connection is checked before it is handed out, and a dead one is closed and dropped rather than used.
